reviews.classification: complete wandering/insight and optional-map palette with retired milestone and superseded primary-view recommendation
reviews.disposition:
Full-content review read all190 original lines, including the five insight/zone/encounter/automation/aftermath considerations, first local proof, Hanzi/atlas comparisons, native command bindings, center-menu clarification, timer-driven integration and final source/reference boundaries. The long initial output lost a few words inside the native-progression row; lines70–110 were reread completely before awarding full coverage.

**Resolve the actual direction conflict.** The header and several closing lines still describe one realm/one prestige as the first milestone. That gate was retired by later direction in [USER_VISION](USER_VISION.md) and [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md); it does not constrain current work. The later center-menu clarification in this document already supersedes field-primary composition. Preserve Hanzi as an endorsed visual possibility and atlas as a regional alternative, without treating either as cancelled, compulsory or implemented. Current [site/exploration rules](SITE_AND_EXPLORATION_RULES.md) and [UI rules](UI_RULES.md) govern a selected slice. Old Village/shop/Rat-step human review and736px/320px mockup checks are dated scope, not today's delivery gate or target-desktop proof.

**Keep the useful loop and its distinctions.** Observation, interpretation, executable response and later planning have different causes; a faculty or exceptional method can connect or bypass stages through actual means. A quiet outing can deliver useful resources without a rare monster. Better perception reveals an existing occurrence rather than silently increasing its spawn rate. Sightings, escape, retained clue and victory have different aftermath. A first-discovery reward settles once, while repeat practice may still produce ordinary supported gains. Unknown events can pause the proposed first outing, but that first policy does not impose one stop cadence on every world or automation route. Foreground-only, one active assignment and no new lethal offline loss were proposed first-slice defaults, not permanent limits on supported concurrency or absent-world behavior.

**A display is distinct from a new simulation.** The menu, list, atlas and glyph field can share stable target IDs, legal commands, costs and observer knowledge. Inspecting does not call travel or begin combat; drawn proximity cannot bypass route/access rules. Decorative terrain needs no actor identity or traversable tile. An integrated expedition view can honestly reflect saved pending actions and aftermath without claiming pathfinding, autonomous ecology, wandering encounters or a global offline clock. The scripted conversation scene demonstrated presentation continuity only. The October2 code observations and external comparisons remain historical evidence; no current module absence, native command behavior, reference availability, gameplay test, build, browser or reload was reverified here.

Retain this palette and [engine expansion](ENGINE_EXPANSION.md) for a selected future binding. Real wandering requires its actual gathering/evidence/encounter/return handlers; a map is optional for deeper books or ordinary actions. Reopen with a named changed decision and current-owner inspection, preserving the visual history and scoped acceptance examples.

ids: five core cases+Mistborn;16 taxonomy families;10-dimension lifecycle;loopsA–D;ward rules;idle/persistence;inheritance;three wishlist rows
reviews.classification: complete sampled progression-magic dossier and original loop palette with later mechanism-first direction qualifying balance prescriptions
reviews.disposition:
Full-content review covers all273 original lines: evidence labels and local-library query, five core comparators plus supplemental Mistborn, all16 taxonomy families, lifecycle matrix, loopsA–D, portable-ward example, persistence/idle contract, safeguards, inherited/acquired/learned distinctions, three acquisition leads and final integration recommendation. This retains useful ideas and chapter/appendix pointers without representing a new source read.

**Evidence remains as sampled.** Direct passage, author/synopsis, character hypothesis, interpretation, original proposal and gap are deliberately distinct. Mage Errant is a narrow author-level case, not a qualified technical adaptation. The Cradle bonus scene does not establish the complete advancement ladder; attunement generations are mark revisions rather than biological inheritance; a speaker's uncertain claim does not become omniscient truth. MoL chapter62 and the Mistborn chapter3 comparison distinguish access, fuel, knowledge and execution without proving a universal hereditary model. The old English-title-only catalog query, readership figures and source availability are September30 observations. They are neither current acquisition gaps nor grounds to redownload a book. No external page/PDF was fetched, catalog searched or source acquired in this reconciliation.

**Preserve mechanisms, qualify the old balance prescriptions.** Knowledge, acquired faculty, control, body compatibility, access to teaching, consumed fuel and committed/reclaimable capacity remain useful separate causes. Retrieval returns what remains committed, not consumed fuel; apparent knowledge need not supply the actual means of execution. However, the taxonomy's fixed caps, one practice objective, one technique slot, compulsory tradeoffs, equivalent milestones, limited catch-up and prohibition of an automatically superior full-spectrum build are local prototype proposals. They are not global design rules. Current [accepted direction](USER_VISION.md), [skills/talents](SKILLS_AND_TALENTS.md) and [learning palette](SKILLS_AND_LEARNING_CONSIDERATIONS_2026-10-18.md) permit exceptional power, overlapping specialties, alternate acquisition, multitasking and imported strength when their mechanisms support them. No balancing tax, forced niche, mandatory weakness or compulsory adapter follows merely because a build is powerful. Compatibility, injury, upkeep or suppression needs an actual local cause.

The ward's charge-on-cleared-encounter example needs its authored payment contract; it does not imply every unused ward triggers or spends fuel. A study-first sequence is a useful ordinary route, not a prohibition on a cheat or faculty granting reliable execution. Diagnostic recovery is an option, not mandatory reversibility for every deliberate permanent change. Safe routine automation and unknown-risk choices can have different selected policies. A prototype's no-cultivation-before-loopA recommendation and one-region/one-prestige framing do not replace today's broader priorities or reinstate the retired first milestone.

**No implementation promotion.** LoopA–D hooks, schema1 descriptions and proposed knowledge namespace are dated planning; they do not prove today's missing systems, require another registry or change an old save by themselves. Current [architecture rules](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md) and existing owners settle the selected transaction, actual carriers and compatibility decision. The wishlist becomes active only for a named source question after current library coverage is checked. Keep these comparisons in this dossier and the linked incumbent skill/learning owners; no mandatory research, cultivation campaign placement, runtime work, test, build, browser or save/import was dispatched or verified.
